Settlement Conference held. Stipulation for entry of judgment in favor of the landlord on the record as follows:
- Deft. has agreed to vacate the premises located at 604 Bush Street, #702, S.F., CA. on 3/17/04 by mid-night.
- Upon vacating of premises, pltf. will pay the deft. the amount of $35,000.00 and agreed to waive all rents from Dec-1-2003 up until Mar-17-2004.
- Parties agreed to 1542 Civil Code release of all claims against each other.
- Pltf. will dismiss the case with prejudice 5 days after release.
- If deft. does not leave the premises, Pltf. will give 24 hour notice ex-parte application to seek judgment and request sheriff's eviction be scheduled.
- There will be no stay of execution.
- Each side to bear their own Atty fees and costs.
- If deft. does not vacate the premises purs. to terms of any agreement, deft will owe rent and judgment will be entered and that includes atty fees.
